title: Aloha Pontoon Rentals
specs: Access to Crab Island and inner coastal waterways
New Bentleys and Bennigtons pontoon boats
Dolphin tours with local guide during feeding time
Must be 21 years old to rent equipment; any age to ride along
No boating license required if over 22 years old
Under 22 can rent with Boater’s Safety Card obtained onsite or previously
Pontoon boats have a 2000 pound weight limit, about 12 people including gear
Jet skis hold up to 3 people or 500 pounds
Accommodates large groups including corporate events and family reunions

blurb: Guests rent pontoon boats or jet skis to explore the inner coastal waterways including Crab Island. Boats come with safety instruction, maps, and included gas. Jet skis are Yamaha 4-stroke Wave Runners that hold up to 3 people and can be rented hourly or longer.
extraNote: Reservations strongly encouraged due to high demand · Alcohol allowed but must have a designated driver; same rules as road · Boats and jet skis allowed only in inner coastal waterways, not ocean or pass · Parking lot on top of the hill off Highway 98 with a big yellow sign reading Aloha Pontoons Parasailing Waverunners; staff will assist loading and unloading.
